title: ZCodeGraph 0.10.0 README Metrics Refresh Roadmap
description: Refresh README release metrics, remove needs-human-setup from the 0.10.0 official release content, consolidate displayed metrics into one coherent evidence set, then retarget v0.10.0.

1-1.label: Release tag boundary and retarget plan

decisions.q: README metrics refresh enters which release?
decisions.note: Because npm/GitHub release has not been confirmed as published in this thread, fix README needs-human-setup before formal release. This implies a new commit and moving v0.10.0 to that commit after validation.

1-2.label: Corpus and benchmark scope

decisions.q: 展示指标刷新采用哪种 scope?
decisions.answer: B. 建立 0.10.0-current-state 统一指标 artifact，README 只引用这份现状指标
decisions.note: 覆盖 indexing snapshot、agent sufficiency 现状、language ownership/support matrix、known caveats。历史 benchmark 可保留为 docs 背景，但 README 不再混用不同日期数字作为主叙事。

decisions.q: VS Code sparse 是否进入 README 展示指标?
decisions.answer: B. 进入 artifact + README 主表，并明确标注 sparse checkout
decisions.note: 实事求是展示 large-repo smoke；不得写成完整 VS Code 指标。README 表格必须标注 sparse checkout 和 corpus identity。

decisions.q: 统一指标跑到什么深度?
decisions.answer: B. Indexing current-state + deterministic sufficiency probes，不跑 agent A/B
decisions.note: 覆盖 current repo/Zustand/Gin/Excalidraw/VS Code sparse indexing baseline，并用 deterministic zcodegraph_explore probes 验证代表性 sufficiency；不做 with/without agent A/B。

decisions.q: README 旧历史指标如何处理?
decisions.answer: B. README 主叙事只保留 0.10.0 current-state，历史 benchmark 移到 details/links
decisions.note: 避免多日期、多方法、多模型指标拼盘。历史 benchmark 仍作为 docs 证据保留，但不作为 README 顶部展示指标。

1-2.notes: Scope complete: four fixed corpora are available; VS Code sparse included in artifact and README with sparse label; run indexing baseline plus deterministic sufficiency probes; README main metrics use only 0.10.0 current-state.

1-3.label: Unified metrics artifact

decisions.q: Deterministic sufficiency probes 的 pass/fail 标准?
decisions.answer: B. 每个 corpus 要求关键符号/route/flow evidence 出现在 zcodegraph_explore 输出中
decisions.note: 不要求完整 agent-stop 证明或 with/without A/B。README 只能表述为 deterministic evidence probes，不写成完整 agent A/B。

1-3.notes: Unified current-state artifact generated with indexing snapshot, profile buckets, deterministic sufficiency probes, RSS unavailable reasons, and VS Code sparse recovery caveat.

1-4.label: README replacement
1-4.notes: README now uses one 0.10.0 current-state metric set, removes needs-human-setup wording, labels VS Code as sparse checkout, and demotes historical A/B/coverage numbers to links.

1-5.label: Validation commit and tag retarget
1-5.notes: Validation passed: npm run build, npm test, git diff --check, and README legacy metric/needs-human-setup scan. Commit/push/tag retarget follows.
